SELECT SOGGLOCK.IDPARTYLOCK
FROM PAPARTYLOCK SOGGLOCK 
WHERE SOGGLOCK.IDPARTYLOCK IN ( 
 ( SELECT SL.IDPARTYLOCK
FROM PAPARTYLOCK SL 
JOIN PAPARTY S ON (S.IDPARTY = SL.IDPARTY) 
WHERE  ( 
 S.TINS >= to_timestamp('17/08/2026 00:28:16','dd/MM/yyyy HH24:MI:SS') 
 OR S.TUPDATE >= to_timestamp('17/08/2026 00:28:16','dd/MM/yyyy HH24:MI:SS') 
 OR SL.DMODIFICATION >= to_date('17/08/2026', 'dd/MM/yyyy') 
) 
 ) UNION ALL (
SELECT SL.IDPARTYLOCK
FROM PAPARTYLOCK SL 
JOIN PAPARTY S ON (S.IDPARTY = SL.IDPARTY) 
 JOIN PAGROUPLIST LA ON (
 LA.IDPARTY = S.IDPARTY
 OR LA.IDMASTERPARTY = S.IDPARTY
) 
WHERE  LA.DMODIFICATION >= to_date('17/08/2026', 'dd/MM/yyyy') 
) 
 )
